∀ (p : outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius.Params),
  outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n → ℝ)
      (O : OracleTemplate.Oracle (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n) (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius.spec.admissible p f O →
        let A := outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.frobenius p.toPublic;
        outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius.spec.successful p f
          (fun seed =>
            OracleTemplate.execute O A
              (fun x =>
                ⌈18 ^ 4 * ↑(min p.m p.n) ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ * p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε ^ 4 +
                        18 ^ 2 * ↑(min p.m p.n) * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 +
                      18 ^ 2 * ↑(min p.m p.n) * p.σ ^ 4 / (p.L * p.Δ * p.ε ^ 2)⌉₊ +
                  1)
              seed.1 seed.2)
          ⟨(↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1), ⋯⟩

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.Params),
  LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.spec.valid q →
    ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n → ℝ),
      LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.FrobeniusSmooth q.L f →
        BddBelow (Set.range f) →
          ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
            (g : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n → Ω → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n),
            LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k s => s k) ↑μ ↑P →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g q.σ →
                ∀ {Ξ : Type} [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) (π : Ξ → ℕ → Ω),
                  Measurable π →
                    MeasureTheory.Measure.map π Q = ↑P →
                      LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.Guarantee q f
                        (fun ξ j =>
                          (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory (LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.publicInput q) g (π ξ)
                                ↑j).2.1)
                        Q

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (p : outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius.Params),
  outputs.Setups.MuonFrobenius.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n → ℝ),
      LongTails.Setups.MuonFrobenius.FrobeniusSmooth p.L f →
        BddBelow (Set.range f) →
          f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W ≤ p.Δ →
            ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
              (g : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n → Ω → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n),
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k s => s k) ↑μ ↑P →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n) Ω (↑μ)
                    f g p.σ →
                  let q := outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.sourceInput p.toPublic (↑(min p.m p.n) * p.L);
                  (∀ (t : ℕ), Measurable fun s => (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s t).2.1) ∧
                    (∀ (t : ℕ),
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                          (fun s =>
                            OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s t).2.1))
                          ↑P) ∧
                      1 / ↑q.T *
                          ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T,
                            ∫ (s : ℕ → Ω),
                              OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm
